body.title: Build the six additive git inputs found by the audit (g5 to g10)
body.summary: Add the optional inputs the t1 audit found missing, each leaving existing calls unchanged, with approval class unchanged and its own test, flagged for the tool owner: git_status `paths` and `untrackedFiles` (all); git_ls_tree `fullTree`; git_log `firstParent`; git_rev_list `parents` (the data gains the parent shas of each commit); git_worktree add `startPoint`; git_diff `againstWorktree` (git diff <from>). Plan amendment of 2026-11-01, made because the audit found six gaps beyond the four t2 builds.
acceptanceChecks: each of g5 to g10 is an optional input; every existing call of the six tools returns what it returned before and the snapshot-compat and approval-class tests pass unchanged
each input is covered by a test against a real temporary repository
section 5 of the migration record marks g5 to g10 as built by t24

tests.name: git-status-paths.test.ts: git_status limits its result to the given paths and lists each untracked file with untrackedFiles all
git-ls-tree-full-tree.test.ts: git_ls_tree fullTree lists from the repository root when cwd is a subdirectory
git-log-first-parent.test.ts: git_log firstParent leaves out the commits merged in from a side branch
git-rev-list-parents.test.ts: git_rev_list parents returns each commit with its parent shas
git-worktree-start-point.test.ts: git_worktree add with createBranch starts the new branch at startPoint
git-diff-against-worktree.test.ts: git_diff againstWorktree compares a rev with the working tree
